newsitem.title: FRANCE: Giscard plan would hit French savers - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: Giscard plan would hit French savers - Arthuis.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday that a proposal by ex-president Valery Giscard d'Estaing to fix a rate of seven francs for one euro would mean a loss for French savers.
Giscard d'Estaing proposed this rate last week to make the euro simple and easy to understand for French people and to allow for a sharp deprecation in the franc.
"Out of a concern for simplicity, Mr. Giscard d'Estaing does not give change," Arthuis told a press briefing.
The franc is currently worth 6.54 ecus. Ecus will be exhcanged one-for-one for euros at the launch of monetary union.
If Giscard d'Estaing's proposal were accepted, the French small saver would see the value of their savings reduced by some six to eight percent, he said.
